text: Scarborough Community Council will introduce bills.

General Bills Scarborough Community Council passed By-laws 1429-2025 to 1434-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bill Scarborough Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 1435-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
